relations.subject: Alexander Faulkner
relations.evidence: British Civil Servant in India. He joined Bombay Civil Service in 1839 and made his career in Customs, Salt, and Opium Department

relations.subject: Alexander Faulkner
relations.evidence: made his career in Customs, Salt, and Opium Department, served in various positions there (1856 he was Assistant Commissioner) at least until 1874.
